# Buttons

A button runs an action; a link drawn as a button goes somewhere. One class, `btn`, then a tone, a size or an icon when the button needs one.

## Examples

The plain `btn` is neutral. `btn-primary` marks the one main action of a screen; the other tones say what an action does.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Save</button>
<button class="btn" type="button">Cancel</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button">Duplicate</button>
<button class="btn btn-success" type="button">Publish</button>
<button class="btn btn-danger" type="button">Delete</button>
<button class="btn btn-warning" type="button">Withdraw</button>
<button class="btn btn-info" type="button">Preview</button>
```

### Outline, subtle, text and link

Quieter forms of the same tones for secondary actions, rows and toolbars. `btn-text` has no fill until hovered; `btn-link` reads as a link and keeps a button's size.

```html
<button class="btn btn-outline-primary" type="button">Outline</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline-danger" type="button">Outline danger</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle-primary" type="button">Subtle</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle-danger" type="button">Subtle danger</button>
<button class="btn btn-text" type="button">Text</button>
<button class="btn btn-link" type="button">Link</button>
```

### Sizes

A size is a word: `btn-xs` 24 px, `btn-sm` 28 px, the default 32 px, `btn-lg` 40 px — the heights of every control of the same size.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button">Extra small</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" type="button">Small</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Default</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" type="button">Large</button>
```

### Icons

An icon sits beside the words, or alone in a square `btn-icon` whose name is its `aria-label`. `btn-close` draws the close glyph by itself.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>New excursion</button>
<a class="btn" href="#btn-icons">Open the site<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>
<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Edit"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button class="btn btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="More actions"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm btn-subtle-danger" type="button" aria-label="Remove"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button>
```

### Groups and toolbars

`btn-group` joins buttons into one control — here a choice of view, each button pressed or not. `btn-toolbar` lays groups and buttons out in a wrapping row.

```html
<div class="btn-toolbar" role="group" aria-label="List view">
	<div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Layout">
		<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="true">List</button>
		<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Board</button>
		<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Calendar</button>
	</div>
	<div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Export">
		<button class="btn" type="button">Export</button>
		<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Export options"><i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
</div>
```

### Toggle and busy

A toggle carries `aria-pressed`. While its action runs, `REDZ.ui.busy(button, promise)` shows a spinner in the button and marks it `aria-disabled`: it keeps the focus and ignores clicks until the promise settles.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="false" data-docs-run="toggle"><i class="bi bi-pin-angle" aria-hidden="true"></i>Pin</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" data-docs-run="busy-button">Save for 2 seconds</button>
```

## States

A state is the attribute accessibility needs anyway, on the button itself: no `active` or `disabled` classes. `aria-expanded` is set by the browser on a button that opens a menu or a dialog.

## Keyboard and accessibility

- `<button type="button">` for an action, `<a href>` for a place; `btn` draws both the same. Enter and Space press a button, Enter follows a link.
- A button with only an icon takes its name from `aria-label`; the icon is `aria-hidden="true"`.
- `disabled` takes a button out of the tab order and hides why. `aria-disabled="true"` keeps it focusable — so a tooltip can say why — and the library swallows its clicks.
- A button that opens a menu or a dialog uses the browser's command: `commandfor` + `command`, never `data-bs-toggle`.
- The focus ring is 2 px of `--redz-focus`, 3:1 against the page in both themes.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `btn-check` | — | review | a toggle is a btn with aria-pressed; a choice is radio inputs |
| `btn-close-white` | — | remove | the close glyph takes the text color |
| `btn-dark` | — | review | no light or dark buttons: btn or btn-text |
| `btn-group-vertical` | — | missing |  |
| `btn-light` | — | review | no light or dark buttons: btn or btn-text |
| `btn-outline-dark` | — | review | btn-outline-secondary |
| `btn-outline-light` | — | review | btn-outline-secondary |
| `data-bs-toggle="button"` | `aria-pressed` | review | switch aria-pressed in your click handler |
